chain_words.nuance: to write a short note quickly
to write a first version that may be changed
general sense of putting words on paper
to write carefully, creating a structured text
to write with great skill and attention to form

explanation: These words all describe producing written text, from a quick note to a carefully crafted work.

usage_notes.difference: 'Write' is the general word for producing text; 'craft' stresses skill and care in shaping the form of the text.
